mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when this trigger is met, or the trigger fires but returns are not statistically different from baseline (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 8% signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the trigger fires but returns are not significantly below baseline (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase of at least 0.4 percentage points in the unemployment rate for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depress consumer and business confidence and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises by >= 0.4pp for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when this trigger is met (p > 0.10), or the trigger occurs but returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline of at least 1% in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals a contraction in economic output, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >= 1% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when this trigger is met (p > 0.10), or the trigger occurs but returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp reduction in the federal funds rate below 1% during a recession (UNRATE > 7%) signals an aggressive easing cycle that boosts risk asset valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when this trigger is met (p > 0.10), or the trigger fires but returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase of at least 0.5% in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth) for six consecutive months signals strengthening household balance sheets and higher consumption, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly growth >= 0.5% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly above zero when this trigger is met (p > 0.10), or the trigger occurs but returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline of at least 0.3 percentage points in unemployment (UNRATE) and a monthly increase of at least 0.2% in average hourly earnings (not available, so use PAYEMS as proxy for labor market tightness) for three months signals a tight labor market with upward wage pressure, which raises input costs and ultimately reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls by >= 0.3pp AND PAYEMS growth >= 0.2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when this trigger is met (p > 0.10), or the trigger occurs but returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 500K units for five consecutive months signals a sustained weakness in the residential construction sector, which drags on materials and financial stocks and results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when this trigger is met (p > 0.10), or the trigger occurs but returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.
